Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_NoRLS;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ', customerid)  as NameID,
    dc.customername as CustomerName,
    dc.customertype as CustomerType,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/0dcace2f-d4fc-4478-98cf-2822a516f847/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/c149b081-c079-4d96-b5b1-b92811155796/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_NoRLS
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
where dc.customerid in (select distinct customerid from dw.dimcustomeraccount
                    where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP'
                    and banksk = 1)
